system.itemDescription: With a proud nomadic tradition, the mighty tauren have roamed across Azeroth. From the vast plains of Mulgore to the rugged peaks of Highmountain and beyond, they embody a reverence for nature and ancestral wisdom. Towering in stature with bovine features and tribal adornments, they evoke a primal aura. Tauren prioritize harmony and balance, serving as fierce defenders of nature and their kin. Despite their imposing presence, they possess a gentle spirit and deep connection to the Earth Mother. Their culture emphasizes wisdom, spirituality, and community, shaping them into compassionate allies and formidable foes alike.
